decision.reason: [ev-cb880878ba69] says only that the `istio.io/gateway-name` label was removed and that `gateway.networking.k8s.io/gateway-name` should be used instead. It does not say which objects carry or read the label, for example gateway Deployments, Pods or Services, or workload selectors in policies. Nothing in the traffic-management section context adds that detail. The proposed exposure guesses that users set the label on Gateway resources, which no evidence supports, and it also uses the wrong group (`networking.k8s.io` instead of `gateway.networking.k8s.io`). To write the exposure condition, we need upgrade-guide or PR text that says where the label was applied or matched, such as Istio-generated gateway workloads or selectors that reference the label.
